The recorded plat’s designation of the 10-acre tract for a public school is an offer of dedication, which the school board’s vote to build can accept. It is not a restrictive covenant, because neither the plat nor the sales brochure creates a private use restriction among lot owners, and it is not a mere unenforceable restriction, because setting land aside for public use on a recorded subdivision plat is the ordinary way to offer that land to the public. Until acceptance, the designation remains only that offer.
CONFIDENCE: 76
